canonical_industry_source: Must equal one of the canonical `industry` strings already governed in src/finengine/catalog.py's GROUPS industry scope_value and documented in docs/MASTER_SCHEMA.md, so a company's existing reviewed industry classification is what selects this pack -- no new classification taxonomy is introduced.
notes: sector_specific_fields is not_applicable for food & agriculture: catalog.py's 'food_agriculture' GROUPS entry only defines food_agriculture_operations KPI fields, with no distinct sector-specific statement template.

crop_production, livestock_volume, raw_milk_volume and yield_per_hectare/cultivated_area are kept recommended rather than required because they only apply to issuers with their own farming/dairy operations (e.g. NADEC, Almarai) and not to a pure branded-food processor/distributor with no agricultural segment -- making them required would misclassify a genuine business-model difference as a data gap.

commodity_input_cost is frequently disclosed only qualitatively ('higher feed costs pressured margins') in the MD&A rather than as a number; such narrative-only disclosure resolves this field as unavailable (not_disclosed), and the margin impact itself is instead captured through the universal profitability category's gross_margin trend, not fabricated into a commodity-cost figure.
